summary: MaintITProvisionRole is a web UI and backend component used for managing IT Provision Role records in the HSPnet system. It provides workflows for viewing, filtering, adding, editing, deleting, and reactivating IT Provision Roles, with actions governed by user permissions and agency context.
purpose: To allow authorized users (System Administrators or Local Administrators) to manage IT Provision Role records. Functions include searching, listing, adding, editing, inactivating, and reactivating roles, filtered by agency and keyword, and respecting workflow and permission boundaries.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for IT Provision Role

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Full name of the IT Provision Role

fields.name: ShortName
fields.description: Abbreviated name of the IT Provision Role

fields.name: Inactive
fields.description: Indicates if the role is inactive (deleted)

workflows.name: View and Filter IT Provision Roles
steps: User can filter by agency, keyword, and show inactive codes.

workflows.name: Add IT Provision Role
steps: Check user permissions (SysAdmin or LocalAdmin at current agency).

workflows.name: Edit IT Provision Role
steps: Show Details view with current data.

workflows.name: Delete (Inactivate) IT Provision Role
steps: Mark role inactive (do not permanently delete).

workflows.name: Reactivate IT Provision Role
steps: User clicks Reactivate on inactive role.

workflows.name: Refresh Data
steps: User triggers refresh (button or agency dropdown change).
GridView is rebound to latest data.

business_rules: Only System Administrators and Local Administrators at the current agency can add/edit/delete/reactivate roles.
Name and ShortName fields are mandatory.
Roles are not permanently deleted, but marked inactive.
conditions: Dropdown.CurrentID(ddAgency) must match UserSession.AgencyID for LocalAdministrator edits.
system_behavior: Panels for errors and warnings are shown/hidden dynamically.
GridView supports alternating row styles, empty data templates, and dynamic actions.
Modal popup extender used for editing/adding roles.
RefreshData re-checks permissions and updates GridView.
exceptions: If agency dropdown is empty, Add is not allowed.
